title: Intermittent order create — orders-api hitting client timeouts to inventory-service
symptoms: read/connect timeouts naming a downstream host
increase in 5xx responses seen by callers
elevated p95 latency on the alerting service
circuit breaker or retry storms toward one dependency
observed_signals: caller CPU and memory stayed close to baseline
downstream_latency_ms on the caller rose toward the configured client timeout
timeout logs named a specific dependency, not the local database
db utilization rose only where the caller held connections during the wait

timeline.event: orders-api began retrying calls to inventory-service
circuit breaker or retry logs referenced inventory-service
inventory-service recovered or was isolated; caller errors receded

contributing_factors: cross-zone latency to inventory-service crossed the client deadline
resolution: investigated cross-zone RTT and packet loss toward inventory-service
pinned traffic to the healthy zone while the path was repaired
recorded the timeout histogram in the incident ticket
lessons_learned: distinguish caller CPU/memory (flat) from outbound latency (up)
retry storms can look like a traffic surge on the caller
